title: Version 1.63.0
html:
Version 1.63.0

August 8th, 2024

Added:

  • Create a basement for your property, going over 100 studs down! So much more building space, so much opportunity...
  • Basements can be paid for a one-time fee of $125,000 per slot, or you can buy the Basements Gamepass and unlock them for all of your slots! The choice is yours.
  • The width of basements automatically sizes to your property size, so if you want a wider basement, expand that property!
  • Flora Lora is now selling wonderous vines! They are able to be colored all of the same colors that you can with the wire tool.
  • You can also buy the More Colors Gamepass if you want even more colors for some reason. (This is formally known as the Creative Wiring gamepass, all gamepasses are now renamed).

Changes:

  • The singular brick you could find at Flora Lora is now DYEABLE with the Dye machine. So many new color options, how delightful!
  • The dyeable bricks function just like the fabric rolls, so you will need to use a Press to create a jar of dye, and a Dye to combine that with the brick.
  • Brick.
  • Jak has been working HARD on modifying the River Cave & Plek Cave. Things are now a lot more 🫧 bubbly!
  • The waterfalls now have 'smoke' (I don't know what it's called) at the bottom of the fall. [hoofer, it's called mist.]
  • Some changes have been made to the tutorial. Most notably, you now start with tools in your inventory, and the rusty axe and pickaxe have been buffed.
  • All doors can now have their width resized all the way down to 0.25, this includes garage doors!
  • Player Spawns now create an invisible part on the client, this should prevent that issue where you would fall through your spawn when loading in.
  • The Blueprint Fabricator's Schematic limit has been changed from 250 -> 500 schematics.
  • The Blueprint Fabricator's max size has been changed from 80 -> 200 studs.
  • The value of Lumite has been lowered by 15% (390 -> ~331 refined, 608 -> ~516 forged).

Fixes:

  • Loads of performance changes have been made for the game. This should hopefully reduce the server lag by a ton.
  • Many touched events for objects such as conveyors, drawers, etc, are now on the client.
  • Fixes for the Roblox physics sleeper have been made, this should be working now when it hasn't been since the release of WIND? (it's a long story...)
  • A bunch of fixes for the build mode have been made, hopefully this becomes easier to use.

Version 1.63.1

August 8th, 2024

Added:

  • Added tallgrass scenery

Changes:

  • The grasslands trees now appear like 'forests'

Version 1.63.2

August 9th, 2024

Changes:

  • In-game moderators now have a chat tag & color
  • A bunch more regions on the map now have dense forests

Fixes:

  • Fixed vinyl regions not going into the basements
  • Fixed a lag method involving the new client touch events
  • Fixed a very rare issue where statues would mysteriously disappear
